result.title: Trainable Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
result.summary: Vector Quantization (VQ) is a rapidly evolving technique for compressing Large Language Model (LLM) weights, reducing memory usage, and speeding up inference. However, extreme compression deteriorates model performance, which is challenging to recover due to the discrete nature of VQ parameters. Existing methods employ training-free approaches that are limited to layer-wise reconstruction loss minimization. To address this limitation, we propose TVQ, a novel method that leverages straight-through estimation to enable gradient descent-based optimization of vector-quantized LLMs. By reformulating VQ LLM optimization with trainable latent weights, TVQ enables arbitrary objective minimization. We constitute our approach by applying TVQ in a block-wise knowledge distillation paradigm, which balances quality and training efficiency, and propose several practical solutions to accelerate training. In experiments on modern LLMs, we demonstrate that TVQ is compatible with modern VQ schemes. As a result, TVQ achieves state-of-the-art quality in low-bit post-training quantization settings with a modest training budget and straightforward PyTorch implementation. For instance, TVQ achieves near-lossless 2-bit quantization for LLaMA2-70B with only 1% accuracy drop on popular Question-Answering benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 针对向量量化压缩 LLM 权重在极低位下性能退化的问题，提出 TVQ：用 straight-through estimation 让量化后的模型以可训练 latent 权重做梯度下降优化，并结合 block-wise 知识蒸馏与加速训练技巧，在 2-bit 等低比特场景取得较好质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但「离散量化参数 + STE + 可训练 latent 权重」的优化方式，可供核查其是否适用于训练含离散 latent 状态或码本的 LVR 模型。
